bluetooth_confirm.title: Set up QuietCool Fan
bluetooth_confirm.description: Found **{name}** ({address}). Click Submit to begin pairing.

pair.title: Pair with {name}
pair.description:
Put the fan in **Pair Mode**, then click Submit.

**Easiest:** open the QuietCool app → your fan → **Pair Mode** (no ladder needed).

**Or:** hold the physical **Pair** button on the fan's wall control unit / controller until the light flashes.

**Already have a Phone ID?** From a previous setup, an ESPHome config, or the QuietCool app — enter it below to skip pairing (the reliable path on newer firmware). Leave blank to pair a new one.

data.phone_id: Phone ID (optional — leave blank to pair)

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the fan over Bluetooth. Ensure the fan is powered on and within range.
error.pair_failed: Pairing failed. Press the Pair button on the fan controller first, then try again.
error.invalid_phone_id: That doesn't look like a valid Phone ID. Enter the exact ID (letters, numbers, and dashes).
error.login_failed: The fan didn't accept that Phone ID. Make sure it's registered on this fan, or leave the field blank to pair a new one.
error.memory_full: The fan's pairing memory is full (it stores up to 50 devices). Factory-reset the controller (QuietCool app → Fan Settings, or hold the Test/Speed button until it beeps), then try pairing again.

abort.no_devices_found: No QuietCool fans were discovered nearby. Ensure the fan is powered on and Bluetooth is enabled.
abort.device_not_found: The selected device is no longer available.
